veranderings.voor: het graan geplant en vee gehad en tog steeds wild gejag
veranderings.na: het graan geplant en vee aangehou, maar hulle het steeds wild gejag
veranderings.rede: Two chained 'en' clauses read heavily; 'vee aanhou' is the idiomatic verb, and 'maar' carries the contrast of 'tog' with the AWS comma before a full clause.

veranderings.voor: bokke en hase gejag vir die vleis
veranderings.na: bokke en hase vir die vleis gejag
veranderings.rede: Afrikaans puts the past participle after the adverbial phrase; the extraposed 'gejag vir die vleis' follows English order.

veranderings.voor: Net soos ons het die boere ook soms
veranderings.na: Net soos ons het die boere soms
veranderings.rede: 'ook' repeats what 'net soos ons' already says.

veranderings.voor: kon hy of sy na tradisionele genesers toe gaan vir hulp
veranderings.na: kon hy of sy vir hulp na tradisionele genesers toe gaan
veranderings.rede: The purpose phrase belongs before the verb group; 'gaan vir hulp' at the end follows English order.

veranderings.voor: sê mense vandag vir die een soort geneser 'n sangoma en vir die ander 'n inyanga
veranderings.na: noem mense vandag die een soort geneser 'n sangoma en die ander soort 'n inyanga
veranderings.rede: 'sê vir ... 'n' is colloquial; 'noem' is the standard written form, and 'die ander soort' keeps the parallel clear.
The second 'het' is redundant when both verbs share the same auxiliary.

veranderings.voor: Maar party genesers het albei soorte werk gedoen.
veranderings.na: Party genesers het egter albei soorte werk gedoen.
veranderings.rede: A sentence opening with 'Maar' is spoken style; 'egter' gives the same contrast in written text and keeps 'party'.

veranderings.voor: Genesers het oor honderde jare op dié manier siek mense bly help.
veranderings.na: Op dié manier het genesers honderde jare lank siek mense bly help.
veranderings.rede: 'oor honderde jare' copies 'over hundreds of years'; Afrikaans says 'honderde jare lank', and fronting 'Op dié manier' links better to the previous sentence.
'Jy kry' for 'there are' is colloquial; 'Daar is' is the neutral written form.

vlae.teks: Hulle het ook ander middels uit die natuur gebruik.
vlae.rede: Vague: 'ander middels' does not say what kind of remedies; making it concrete would need content, so it is flagged rather than changed.

vlae.teks: 'n Sangoma het geestelike leiding gegee. Hy of sy het die voorouers om leiding gevra.
vlae.rede: 'leiding' appears in two consecutive sentences with different givers; avoiding it would shift the meaning or the glossary-matched wording, so it is left for the reviewer or writer.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry is 'nyanga', but the lesson and its glossary headword use 'inyanga' throughout, so the protection never matches the text. A person should decide which form is meant and align the entry (the word was not changed).

The entry protects 'geslag' in the sense of gender, but here it appears only in 'van geslag tot geslag' (generation), which is correct; no change proposed, noted so the entry's reason is not read as applying here.
